70.030 · A: 1 · B: Limited to modelled repo-style transactions with cross-product master netting agreements involving OTC derivatives. The gross exposures of these repo-style transactions (i.e. before collateral and netting) must be included with the notional amount of OTC derivatives in the exposure class schedules.
